requirements.summary: Requested claims are exact and never silently downgraded.
requirements.machine_verification: The typed facade maps the three selectable profiles exactly. Generated outputs exercise the combined, archive and standard selections through separate claims and metadata checks. Requests for an unsupported declaration or invalid accessible content fail before delivering any bytes or chunks. WTPDF reuse and PDF/A-4f are not selectable.

requirements.summary: Number, ordering, identifier, escaping, newline, xref, and package-owned DEFLATE choices are fixed package-versioned byte policies.
Font selection assigns whole source grapheme clusters to exact validated static instances before shaping.
The Code to Sub containment correction applies only when Sub is admitted. The current role set admits Code and excludes Sub.
requirements.machine_verification: The role whitelist excludes the corrected parent or child regardless of containment.

requirements.summary: The WP to Figure containment correction applies only to supported warichu. The current role set admits Figure and excludes WP.
requirements.machine_verification: The role whitelist excludes the corrected parent or child regardless of containment.

requirements.summary: Logical metadata requires authored title and language while timestamps and identifiers are explicit or deterministically derived.

Measured custom blocks from separately authored extensions remain data only and unsplittable: their paragraphs become one Div of P elements and their measured box is proven to hold the content without clipping or shrinking. Native callouts are a separate data-only path whose bounded rich children retain one logical Div across page fragments; each rectangular fragment panel is /Artifact <</Type /Layout>> content with no MCID painted before its fragment's marked content. Preparation reports name observations by authored path without PDF object identity and leave the prepared bytes unchanged.
The private structural emitter writes deterministic PDF 2.0 objects, indirect stream lengths, a fixed-width unfiltered xref stream, startxref, and EOF through one buffered/chunk transition.

Flow figures own validated vector, raster, grouped, and multi-command drawings as one Figure with a non-empty /Alt and one marked-content sequence; a caption is Sect > (Figure, Caption > P) with a CaptionFor relationship, so it stays exposed independently of /Alt and is the last child of a non-transparent parent; a figure that does not fit is rejected unless ScaleToFit explicitly scales only its drawing, uniformly and above its floor; in-flow decorations are /Artifact <</Type /Layout>> content with no MCID that move with the next flow block.
A GoTo action D entry accepts only an explicit or named destination.
Name, ID, number, and ParentTree entries seal into deterministic fixed-fanout plans with exact root, child, ordering, Limits, and earlier-store value rules.

Rich paragraph inlines lower in authored order to Em, Strong, Link, and Span structure elements of the PDF 2.0 namespace and Code and Quote elements of the PDF 1.7 standard namespace, declared only when used, inside one P; language spans carry /Lang, abbreviations carry /E, links never nest, and every inline link owns one OBJR-referenced link annotation per page its text is painted on, with active quadrilaterals covering its painted runs. Fixed-width destination-page references resolve to exact Unicode after accepted pagination, inherit their authored inline ownership, language and style, and create no link unless enclosed by an authored Link; reference-only paragraphs, cells, mandatory segments and links retain real occurrences, and authored-break separators remain occurrence-owned ActualText on semantic paint only.

Private PDF lexical emission uses exact canonical booleans, integers, finite fixed-decimal reals, names, byte strings (the shorter of an escaped literal or uppercase hex), and text strings (printable ASCII as PDFDocEncoding bytes, otherwise UTF-16BE with a BOM).

Facade lists lower to L > LI > (Lbl, LBody) in authored order: each item's generated label is an Lbl content item with a source-to-presentation fact, and its lead paragraph and subsequent rich paragraphs, source blocks, figures with their authored captions, ordinary tables, bounded native callouts and nested lists remain children of one logical LBody across pages. Every L declares its ListNumbering; explicit line breaks, page breaks, spacers and keeps produce no structure.
A named-destination dictionary uses SD as defined by GoTo action Table 202.
Private PDF object construction uses dense typed IDs, flat edge stores, checked dimensions, canonical dictionary ordering, and explicit stream payload and length-object references.

Outline preorder seals into deterministic parent, sibling, child, root, and visible-descendant Count facts without synthetic balancing items. The root Count is present only when at least one nonleaf item is open.

First-page and continuation-page templates reserve header, footer, and first-page lead regions of fixed height before flow; furniture text and drawings paint on every page of their template as page-content artifacts (/Artifact with /Type /Pagination and /Subtype /Header, /Footer, or /PageNum) that carry no MCID and belong to no structure element, while a lead region's blocks are a semantic Div first in reading order; page and total-page fields resolve to exact values through explicit reference stabilization, and every reserved width and slot is proven to fit on every painted page. Explicit nonnested full-body-page scopes select predeclared opening and continuation frames and an authored short running label or reset; the scope adds no semantic container. Running labels and configured page-label fields remain MCID-free furniture artifacts, empty resets paint no text, and all scoped body, panel and repeated-header placements consume the accepted frame.
Resource kinds and dense identities seal into stable canonical names in explicit kind order without map iteration.

Preformatted source blocks retain one canonical LF source in a paragraph containing a PDF 1.7 Code element; canonical ActualText and real-line occurrence ranges preserve logical source order across visual-line page continuations. Empty lines reserve geometry without synthetic characters or glyphs. Local registered typography stays independent of body and furniture, and optional padded fragment backgrounds are Layout artifacts without MCIDs. Optional original-UTF8 foreground ranges map through tab/CRLF normalization, split only accepted paint runs, preserve line occurrence identity and use the existing profile-managed sRGB path.
Blank pages lower deterministically to a fixed-fanout left-packed balanced page tree, page dictionaries, resources, and consecutive content-stream length pairs.

Facade tables retain authored order, caption and row groups, regular row grids, typed Scope and ColSpan, and explicit Headers for both data and header cells. Referenced headers have generated IDs and IDTree membership. Repainted continuation headers are Pagination artifacts.
The private minimal visual kernel emits checked geometry, typed color and images, exact meaningful-paint ownership, page and contextual Artifacts, MCIDs, ParentTree rows, and mixed structure order.
Permissions dictionaries are excluded by package policy.
A catalog Version entry, if any, names a PDF 2.x version.
The file begins at byte zero with %PDF-2.0, an EOL, and a four-byte binary comment.
No document information dictionary or PieceInfo is ever emitted.
Encryption is excluded by package policy and rejected if present in a lowered plan.
The trailer carries a file identifier and nothing follows the final end-of-file marker.
Cross-reference data is a single cross-reference stream; no classic xref table is emitted.
Hexadecimal strings use an even count of hexadecimal digits.
Streams never reference external file data (F, FFilter, FDecodeParms).
Every stream Length equals the exact encoded byte count.
Only FlateDecode and DCTDecode filters are used; LZW and non-standard filters never are.
Every PDF name, including font and structure type names, is valid UTF-8.
Indirect object headers use single white-space separators.
Inline images are never emitted.
Optional content is excluded by package policy.
Alternate presentations and presentation steps are excluded by package policy.
Document requirements are excluded by package policy.
Every font is a well-formed Type 0 font with a CIDFontType2 descendant.
Composite fonts use the predefined Identity-H CMap and an identity CIDToGIDMap.
Every rendered font program is embedded as FontFile2 and defines every referenced glyph; caller fonts must be legally embeddable.
Font dictionary widths agree with the embedded font program.
ToUnicode values never contain U+0000, U+FEFF, or U+FFFE.
ActualText replacement text never contains Private Use Area scalars.
Text never references the .notdef glyph.
Simple and TrueType-encoded fonts are excluded by package policy.
Content streams use only ISO 32000-2 operators and explicit resource dictionaries.
Exactly one GTS_PDFA1 output intent embeds the packaged sRGB2014 monitor profile; no DestOutputProfileRef.
ICCBased colour spaces use validated ICC profiles from the supported allowlist.
Device colour is characterized by the PDF/A output intent.
Separation and DeviceN colour are excluded by package policy.
CMYK colour and overprint are excluded by package policy.
Transfer functions and halftones are excluded and rejected if present.
Images use permitted bit depths without interpolation, alternates, or OPI.
JPEG 2000 is excluded by package policy.
Form XObjects never carry OPI data.
Reference XObjects are excluded by package policy.
Only the Normal blend mode is used, and transparency is characterized by the output intent.
Only link annotations are emitted.
Every annotation is printable and never hidden, invisible, or no-view.
Link annotations need no appearance; any appearance is a single normal appearance stream.
Interactive forms and widget annotations are excluded by package policy.
Only URI and GoTo actions are emitted, never chained or JavaScript actions.
Additional-action entries are excluded by package policy.
The catalog references an unfiltered, well-formed UTF-8 XMP metadata stream with a canonical packet header.
The XMP packet declares exactly pdfaid:part 4 and pdfaid:rev 2020 without pdfaid:conformance, only for a validated claim.
Embedded and associated files are excluded by package policy.

The static PDF/A-4 claim uses the pinned validator profile and available public sources. Direct reconciliation of the remaining ISO 19005-4:2020 text follows when the full edition is acquired, including rendering intent, digital signatures and general file conditions.
requirements.human_verification: Reconcile the full purchased ISO 19005-4:2020 edition clause by clause and add evidence for any newly identified applicable requirements.

requirements.summary: The catalog XMP identifies PDF/UA part 2, revision 2024, in the PDF/UA identification schema.
requirements.machine_verification: The public references pass the explicit ua2 and 4 profiles on the same emitted PDF. Five isolated XMP mutations each fail the corresponding 5-1 through 5-5 rule, including wrong part or revision prefixes.

requirements.summary: Every tagged document's catalog declares /MarkInfo << /Marked true >>.

requirements.summary: AcroForms, widgets, XFA, field actions and interactive signatures are outside the static combined subset. Static semantic form fields with PrintField attributes are also outside the public vocabulary.
requirements.machine_verification: The facade has no widgets or semantic form-field input. Static lowering rejects AcroForm and XFA keys and accepts only link annotation subtypes. Accepted reusable Form XObjects contain visual paint, which the independent forms checker verifies.

requirements.summary: The catalog references a Metadata/XML stream with dc:title reflecting the document title. A visible title is optional.
requirements.machine_verification: The public letter retains an authored XMP title, with no visible title element and explicit combined validation. Separate title-removal and Metadata/XML subtype controls fail the pinned 8.11.1 rules.
requirements.human_verification: Check that the metadata title identifies the document.

requirements.machine_verification: roc_facade_expect; every_facade_snapshot_rebaselined_with_the_entry; independent_structure_semantics_checker_requires_it_whenever_metadata_exists; mutation_twins_remove_and_falsify_it Pinned veraPDF controls: display-document-title.

requirements.summary: Article threads are outside the combined navigation vocabulary.
requirements.machine_verification: No article-thread object or constructor is present.

requirements.summary: Outlines are useful in longer documents. The visible page numbering and PDF page labels agree, including documents whose visible numbers differ from physical page indices.
requirements.machine_verification: The public technical manuals reconcile the authored running footer, contents links, semantic headings, outline, and configured PageLabels against independent expectations on both scales. A one-edit PageLabels prefix mutation disagrees with the visible footer and fails the check.
requirements.human_verification: Determine whether the document is long enough to merit the recommended outline. The standards leave that judgment to the reviewer. Check that existing outline entries identify the intended sections and that page labels match the numbering readers perceive.

requirements.summary: The facade admits static URI and GoTo actions. Script actions and coordinate-mapped URI actions are package exclusions.
requirements.machine_verification: The authored and validated action unions carry a URI or an internal destination. URI dictionaries omit IsMap, so the condition requiring equivalent functionality elsewhere in real content does not arise. The independent navigation checker rejects a URI twin with IsMap set to true. The static lowered-plan checks reject script keys and unsupported action kinds.

requirements.summary: Embedded files, associated files and file-attachment annotations are package exclusions in the static combined subset.
requirements.machine_verification: The facade has no file-attachment or associated-file input. Static lowering rejects EmbeddedFiles and AF keys, with independent structural checks on accepted output and an injected AF twin. Consequently the clauses on meaningful EmbeddedFiles descriptions, alternative and supplementary file associations and metadata, and accessibility of embedded material essential to understanding have no triggering input in this subset.

requirements.summary: The catalog references one structure tree, and structure elements link back to their actual parents.
requirements.machine_verification: Structure-tree checker traverses actual lowered objects, checking ownership and back references, and rejects corrupted structure. Pinned veraPDF controls: structure-root.

requirements.summary: Tag real content with appropriate semantics, preserve authored logical order and fragment identity, and identify artifacts according to their context and coherent consumption units.
requirements.machine_verification: The bounded facade emits page artifacts for decoration and furniture, repeated table headers and contents leaders. Authored real content, including intrinsic drawing labels, has a semantic owner with stable logical order and continuation identity. Separate contextual artifact authoring is unavailable. The manual oracle rejects tagged content nested in a page artifact. Removing a running header classification fails the pinned veraPDF rule. The fixed-page oracle checks authored structure order independently of stream paint order and rejects isolated changes to either order, frame geometry, and artwork layering.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm authored roles, real versus artifact classification, logical order, artifact grouping and order, and semantic reading across fragments.

requirements.summary: Supported roles are assigned to the standard namespace that defines them. The bounded vocabulary uses no role mapping or custom namespaces.
requirements.machine_verification: The checker rejects wrong-namespace twins for P and Quote. Semantic validation rejects unsupported namespaces and roles before lowering. Pinned veraPDF controls: nonstandard-structure-role.

requirements.summary: Meaningful headings use explicit numbered structure roles and an appropriate level. Generic H is ineligible for this profile.
requirements.machine_verification: Facade authoring accepts numbered H1 through H6 after validation of the stated levels. Its heading progression check is a package policy. No combined entry point can author a generic H. The emitted letter uses H1 for a section heading, and changing only that role to H triggers 8.2.5.12-1.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm the selected levels match the logical hierarchy.

requirements.summary: The combined authoring vocabulary excludes footnotes, endnotes and other Note and FENote structures.
requirements.machine_verification: No authoring constructor or normalized role is admitted for this family.

requirements.summary: The structure-tree root has exactly one explicitly PDF 2.0 Document child.
requirements.machine_verification: The semantic and independent object checks verify the root role, namespace and ownership. Pinned veraPDF controls: single-document-root and document-namespace.
requirements.human_verification: Where a DocumentFragment is supported, assert its content originates in another document.

requirements.summary: A link structure element owns its associated annotation and contiguous logical content. Distinct destinations have distinct logical links, and fragments of a single link retain that link. Annotation appearances have no marked-content references.
requirements.machine_verification: Public navigation attaches tagged whole annotation objects to their logical link, with each continued fragment in one link and structured targets preserved. Two cross-page annotations in the combined navigation facade fixture resolve to a single Overview link. Pinned controls change their enclosing role or retarget exactly one fragment. The independent owner oracle also rejects a URI mixed with a GoTo target under the same logical link.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm link purpose, semantic identity across fragments, annotation order and association with the intended text.

requirements.summary: The combined authoring vocabulary excludes ruby and warichu structures.
requirements.machine_verification: These roles and their specialized text layout are unavailable.

requirements.summary: An L whose items carry Lbl children declares a ListNumbering attribute other than None.
requirements.machine_verification: every facade L, including the plain-text bullets, lowers a List-owned /A << /ListNumbering /O /List >> (/Disc or the number style); roc_facade_and_kernel_expects; structure_semantics_checker_requires_ListNumbering_other_than_None_on_every_L_with_labelled_items_with_a_mutation_twin; layout_policies_harness_family Pinned veraPDF controls: list-numbering.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm the selected numbering reflects the author’s intended labels.

requirements.summary: Continuing one distinct authored list from another is outside the combined vocabulary. Page fragmentation keeps one L and does not create multiple authored lists.
requirements.machine_verification: Existing pagination cases verify that fragments of one list retain that list.

requirements.summary: Each TH declares Scope. Every TH or TD to which a header pertains declares its explicit Headers, with targets resolving through IDTree and typed HeaderFor relationships.
requirements.machine_verification: Explicit associations follow authored row and column scopes. The bounded model rescans mixed and spanning rectangles independently for header and data cells, and the combined file oracle checks each association and ID. It rejects dropping a row header’s applicable column heading, omitting data-cell Headers, or substituting a real header from the wrong column. The planner accounts for the existing aggregate budget before storing associations. Small exact limits and public byte and chunk rejections test the bound.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm the row and column headers communicate the intended relationships to the corresponding data cells.

requirements.summary: Tables are regular: every row's column spans sum to the table's column count, no cell spans rows, and rows are grouped once by THead, TBody, and TFoot; an irregular grid is rejected before layout, never flattened.
requirements.machine_verification: table_grid_mismatch_and_row_span_rejections_in_semantic_planning; structure_semantics_checker_grid_regularity; atomic_table_negatives_emit_no_bytes Pinned veraPDF controls: table-column-span. The table-row-span, table-body-row-span and table-column-span veraPDF twins isolate group and row regularity. The facade disallows row spans altogether and rejects invalid column widths before layout, so row-span/column-span intersections cannot arise in a supported file.

requirements.summary: The Figure structure encloses the paint of its illustrative unit and exposes an alternate description or an equivalent text representation as applicable.
requirements.machine_verification: Labelled drawings place the graphic mark, including its background, and every Unicode label mark under one Figure in source label order. The independent Figure, vector and manual checks compare the marks, their source text and caption ownership. Separate controls remove Alt, change caption placement, swap label ownership with the caption while keeping paint identical, or reverse label order.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm that every meaningful illustration or labelled drawing has appropriate alternative or replacement text and the associated caption.

requirements.summary: Mathematical and scientific formula structures, MathML, and associated files are outside the combined authoring vocabulary.
requirements.machine_verification: No such semantic constructor, normalized role or associated file is admitted.

requirements.summary: A table of contents uses PDF 1.7 TOC and TOCI roles, each item identifies its semantic target through Ref, and leaders are artifacts.
requirements.machine_verification: Contents fixtures exercise a PDF 1.7 TOC and one TOCI per entry, explicit Ref matching both structure destinations, cross-page fragmentation and artifact leaders. Pinned veraPDF control contents-item-reference removes only Ref and fails 8.2.5.8-1 on generated bytes.
requirements.human_verification: Check that titles and references identify the corresponding logical sections.

requirements.summary: The combined authoring vocabulary preserves intended titles, parts, sections, paragraphs, labels, spans, inline quotations, emphasis and source code as the appropriate semantic roles.
requirements.machine_verification: The combined rich-inline and nested container files preserve each authored role, its namespace and logical text. The independent expectations reject isolated valid-role substitutions for inline owners, Title, P, Lbl, Part and Sect. The combined source and foreground controls verify exact source ownership and text under Code even when paint is split by color. Heading, label intent and each semantic grouping also remain author review obligations.
requirements.human_verification: Review appropriate meanings for their chosen roles, including a heading for its section, visible title distinct from heading, inline quotations, emphasis and code source.

requirements.summary: Public combined authoring excludes articles, block quotations, sidebars, custom NonStruct role mappings, Sub subdivisions, general annotation roles, semantic form fields, indexes and bibliographies.
requirements.machine_verification: These roles cannot be selected through the typed facade or provided by a custom drawing. Inline quotations retain their own supported Quote role.

requirements.summary: ARIA, DPUB-ARIA and arbitrary namespace-owned attributes are outside the combined authoring vocabulary.
requirements.machine_verification: The structure attribute encoder only emits the supported typed standard owners.

requirements.summary: Independently meaningful visual properties requiring a standard Layout attribute are outside the supported facade. Themes, color scopes, callout panels, table presentation and source highlighting provide styling.
requirements.machine_verification: The typed facade has no constructor for semantic Layout attributes. The semantic kernel rejects general Layout attributes, and the independent oracle rejects an injected Layout owner on the combined rich-inline fixture.

requirements.summary: Applicable Table, List and Artifact properties use their standard owners and typed values. Authored semantics are conveyed by content and structure independently of presentation styling.
requirements.machine_verification: Independent combined fixtures check supported Table and List properties, including invalid Scope, missing applicable Headers and ListNumbering with a substituted owner. Artifact classification and subtypes have independent controls. The combined rich-flow oracle checks the authored Warning label, logical grouping and decorative panel separately. The styled rich-inline oracle rejects an injected Layout owner, and the public report supplies StructureMeaningful and ArtifactClassificationMeaningful for a scoped styled warning.
requirements.human_verification: Check that changing a visual treatment would preserve the meaning conveyed by the authored content, roles and alternatives. A visual property with independent semantic meaning requires a Layout attribute outside the supported scope.

requirements.summary: Real text has the intended Unicode representation. Fallback-requiring PUA text needs a non-PUA replacement or alternate, and replacement strings do not contain PUA.
requirements.machine_verification: The combined source block and foreground files preserve the exact canonical Unicode stream across wraps, foreground ranges, blank lines and original tabs. The styled and mixed-face page-reference fixtures check generated label text, inherited face and language, and exact separator ownership. The public ordered policy checks exact per-face Unicode while the advanced text fixtures exercise transformation capabilities beyond the facade. Pinned emitted twins isolate a private-use glyph mapping, Alt and ActualText. Public caller-font controls prove that real PUA is rejected before replacement planning even when the font maps it, and public string controls reject PUA in each authorable replacement or alternate field.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm that expansions, replacements and equivalents convey the intended content.

requirements.summary: The catalog contains a nonempty document language and effective language is declared for all content and human-readable strings.
requirements.machine_verification: The catalog carries the authored default for content and human-readable PDF strings. Facade language spans lower explicit changes for their text, as the combined French and Han fixtures show. The public byte and chunk paths reject recognized BCP 47 placeholders and tags starting with the private-use singleton x with the authored path. Standalone PDF strings use their effective inherited language. KernelLex rejects U+001B at its original byte offset, so single-language authored strings cannot inject a PDF language change. Pinned veraPDF control: document-language. An independent authored oracle also rejects a valid but unintended replacement of a scoped language.
requirements.human_verification: Check registry assignments and applicable private agreements. Confirm each tag resolves to the actual specific natural language and each standalone PDF string uses its inherited language.

requirements.summary: Embedded CID fonts cover all rendered glyphs, use the expected indices and metrics, and map every used code to valid Unicode without .notdef.
requirements.machine_verification: The exact combined outputs pass 4 and ua2 and the requested WTPDF variants pass wt1a. The independent font oracle checks the embedded FontFile2 program, CIDToGIDMap, CIDSystemInfo, per-glyph widths and Unicode map for every Type 0 bundle. Pinned controls exercise omitted CIDToGIDMap and font program, out-of-range CID, width mismatch, absent and BOM Unicode maps, and .notdef. Non-Identity encodings and vertical metrics are outside the facade subset.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm that subscriptions or special agreements are unnecessary for legal embedding and unlimited, universal rendering, and that font subsetting is permitted.

requirements.summary: The supported Type 0 fonts use the predefined Identity-H encoding CMap. User-specified embedded encoding CMaps are outside this subset.
requirements.machine_verification: The facade emits the predefined Identity-H encoding for each composite font. The combined oracle reconstructs all Type 0 bundles and rejects changing the encoding name to Identity-V. Embedded or chained encoding CMaps remain separately excluded.

requirements.summary: The combined subset does not emit or accept custom encoding CMaps, their WMode values, or chained encoding CMaps.
requirements.machine_verification: ToUnicode is a separate Unicode mapping and is covered by the rendered glyph/font requirements.

requirements.summary: The font encoder emits composite Type 0 fonts with a CIDFont descendant. Simple symbolic and non-symbolic TrueType PDF fonts are outside this subset.
requirements.machine_verification: Simple fonts and their encodings are unavailable through the typed font owner.

requirements.summary: Human-readable PDF strings do not contain Unicode private-use code points.
requirements.machine_verification: Public controls inject private-use characters separately into an outline title, page-label prefix, expansion, and figure alternative. Archive accepts each document. AccessibleArchive rejects each supplied field with its located diagnostic before producing bytes or a chunk encoder. Pinned emitted-file controls exercise outline text, Alt and ActualText independently. Link annotation descriptions are unavailable in the facade. XML XMP content is governed by separately recorded metadata rules.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm each readable string conveys the intended information.

requirements.summary: Optional-content dictionaries, configurations and the AS entry are outside the combined subset.
requirements.machine_verification: StaticPdfA4 excludes optional content and the authoring vocabulary has no optional-content constructor.

requirements.summary: Actionable in-document links identify their semantic target through a structure destination. Direct GoTo actions and named destinations carry the applicable structured destination entries.
requirements.machine_verification: An independent object oracle checks structure and page targets. Dedicated errata requirements record the GoTo and named destination twins. Pinned veraPDF controls: internal-structure-destination.
requirements.human_verification: Check that each authored reference leads to the intended logical section.

requirements.summary: Every page of a tagged document declares /Tabs /S, so annotation tab order follows the structure order.
requirements.machine_verification: tagged_page_lowering; independent_structure_semantics_checker_checks_every_page; mutation_twin_changes_the_tab_order Pinned veraPDF controls: link-tab-order.

requirements.summary: The conditional equality requirement applies when a link annotation and its directly enclosing structure both provide descriptions. The combined facade does not expose either field on links.
requirements.machine_verification: The combined facade constructs annotations with NoDescription and provides no Link Alt authoring. Advanced navigation scaffolding that can emit a description is outside this profile.
requirements.human_verification: Confirm the authored link text identifies its purpose and gives appropriate context.

requirements.summary: Generated real link annotations are visible and viewable. Invisible and persistent NoView annotations would require artifact semantics and are outside the authoring subset.
requirements.machine_verification: The public invoice emits a real viewable Link, verified by the independent annotation checker and explicit ua2 validation. The invisible-link and no-view-link controls isolate each prohibited flag combination.

requirements.summary: Markup, stamp, ink, popup and watermark annotations are outside the combined subset.
requirements.machine_verification: Only link annotations are provided by the typed authoring and navigation stages.

requirements.summary: Attachment, sound, movie, screen, printer-mark, trap-network, 3D and RichMedia annotations are outside the combined subset.
requirements.machine_verification: Only link annotations are provided. The static archive independently excludes external files and multimedia.

requirements.summary: Element identifiers are non-empty, unique, stored in ascending byte order, and owned by exactly one structure element; each lowers as /ID and the balanced StructTreeRoot /IDTree maps every lowered identifier back to exactly that element, except that a TH or TD identifier that no /Headers attribute names does not lower, because nothing in the file resolves it. /Headers targets name existing identifiers.

The supported containment rules and the URI action and embedded-file requirements have been reconciled against the full published editions, the pinned errata and the corresponding WTPDF accessibility provisions.
requirements.machine_verification: The contributor inventory records the direct review of all 53 Table 5 rows. The independent checker validates the supported edges, cardinality and inherited rules, accounting for 22 more permissive veraPDF role pairs. Isolated controls reject prohibited URI action flags and embedded-file carriers.

requirements.summary: A structure element carries /Lang exactly when its explicit, well-formed language differs from the language it inherits; the Document element inherits the catalog /Lang. Facade language spans own their text, so every marked-content sequence has its owning element's effective language and needs no marked-content /Lang.
requirements.machine_verification: The scoped language parser rejects malformed subtag structure and repeated variants or extension singletons without regard to case. Both facade export paths report the authored location, and the catalog separately retains its language/script/region subset. Emitted controls replace one scoped language with duplicate variants or singletons and are rejected by the independent structural checker. The combined mixed and ordered fixtures pin authored French and Han scopes. The independent rich oracle rejects a structurally valid wrong language. Pinned veraPDF control: invalid-language.

requirements.summary: The supported mixed PDF 2.0 and PDF 1.7 structure roles obey applicable ISO/TS 32005 Table 5 edges, content-item and cardinality rules. PDF/UA-2 supplies the separate list body and Caption-position requirements.
requirements.machine_verification: Reviewed all 53 published Table 5 rows in both directions. The bounded checker reconciles 900 role pairs, including Part and Div inherited containment, and records 22 more permissive pinned veraPDF pairs. Eleven of those pairs require grouping contexts outside the bounded Caption, Code or Link authoring subset. The remaining eleven lack an allowed published edge. The independent and kernel checks cover supported root cardinality, content items, contextual Artifact placement and child cardinality. Exact role-only mutations reject Quote with Div and a direct Link with P. Pinned veraPDF controls: structure-containment and single-document-root.

requirements.summary: Prepared documents contain exact resolved layout, semantic ownership, scenes, validated resources, bounded work, and no speculative handlers or unresolved references.
AccessibleArchive maps exactly to Pdf20, StaticPdfA4, and PdfUa2.
requirements.machine_verification: The public invoice, report and letter select AccessibleArchive and their original PDFs independently pass explicit veraPDF 4 and ua2. The package contracts check the exact claim set. A public profile rejection must return a located error through both bytes and chunks without an output.

requirements.summary: Archive maps exactly to Pdf20 and StaticPdfA4.
Standard maps exactly to Pdf20.
ICC profiles, typed component counts, color spaces, output intent, and blend space cross the trusted boundary as validated explicit facts.
Raster and JPEG resources retain checked packed planes or encoded bytes with dimensions, color, alpha, and orientation evidence.
Structure element, identifier, navigation destination, and annotation identities stay distinct. Supported non-parental relations connect their typed endpoints without creating a second parent.
requirements.machine_verification: The normalized store checks identifiers, HeaderFor, CaptionFor, LabelFor and ContentsTarget, and rejects unsupported generic cross-relations. Caption and label associations are expressed through the appropriate grouping and order. Table headers resolve through IDTree, and TOCI Ref must name the same structure element as the paired link destination.
